events.event: IHSG fell 7.03% over the week to close at 5,057.05 on Friday 30 October, after the MSCI proposal to reclassify Indonesia and heavy foreign selling.
events.key_numbers: IHSG 5,057.05 (-0.80%, -41.01 pts on day) · -7.03% week · support 4,907 / resistance 5,317 (MNC Sekuritas) · rupiah Rp18,158/USD
events.why_it_matters: A 7% weekly drop hits the savings and portfolios of millions of retail investors.
events.spreading_evidence: Weekly outlook pieces across Kontan and others

events.event: BEI stops counting High Shareholding Concentration (HSC) stocks in the IHSG calculation from Monday 2 November.
events.key_numbers: 81 HSC stocks excluded (per BEI 26 Oct) · effective 2 Nov 2026 · IHSG 5,057.05 at prior close
events.why_it_matters: The index itself changes composition on Monday, so IHSG moves may not be comparable with last week.

events.event: BPS is expected to release October 2026 inflation and the manufacturing PMI reading is due around the start of the week; analysts expect inflation to rise.
events.key_numbers: No consensus figure published · exact BPS date to confirm (usually first working day, 2 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: Rising inflation squeezes household spending and limits room for rate cuts.

events.event: US midterm elections take place on 3 November, a global risk event for markets and the rupiah.
events.key_numbers: 3 Nov 2026 · Fed funds 3.75%-4.00% · hike not ruled out late 2026/early 2027 (Kontan)
events.why_it_matters: US political outcomes can move the dollar and foreign money flows in and out of Indonesia.

events.event: BPS is expected to announce Q3 2026 GDP growth this week, alongside trade balance and FX reserves data.
events.key_numbers: Q2 2026 growth 5.29% (released 5 Aug) · Q3 date not confirmed, likely ~5 Nov · FX reserves and property price index also due
events.why_it_matters: Shows whether the economy is holding up while stocks and the rupiah fall.

events.event: MSCI announces its November index review on 12 November; Kontan says investors are bracing for the results the following week.
events.key_numbers: 12 Nov 2026 · IHSG -16.70% over October period (per E0441)
events.why_it_matters: The result decides how much more foreign money may leave Indonesian stocks.
